title: Expose the admitted canonical result text adapter at the production-application boundary

scope.contract: Expose a stateless bootstrap-module entry that accepts an already-published canonical_result_t as INTENT(IN) and delegates byte-for-byte to the unchanged admitted canonical result text adapter.
scope.physical_state_owner: None; serialization observes an accepted result and does not capture or modify model state.
scope.restart_or_rollback: None; no continuation or trial state is created or mutated.
scope.mass_owner: Unchanged; serializer reports fields already present in canonical_result_t and does not add, infer, publish, or book fluxes.
scope.io_boundary: No file, path, unit, parser, or output-file management. Return text in memory only.

qualification_gates: Compile the changed application-bootstrap module and focused binding test with GNU Fortran at O0 and O2.
Binding output is exactly identical to direct invocation of the admitted M1-C4 serializer for a representative canonical result.
Input result remains unchanged and returned text remains independent after subsequent input mutation.
Source scan confirms no file/path/unit/parser calls in the binding routine.
Preserve exact M1-C4 serializer/contracts blobs and the existing PPA-WU01 bootstrap route.
nonclaims: Does not map fmr_serialized_column_result_t to canonical_result_t or change production physics execution.
Does not admit legacy BAL/BLC/CSV equivalence, output files, a stable external format, or broad output composition.
Does not canonically admit a broader application or close PPA-OUTPUT-LEGACY, M1, or the migration.
decision_rule: Keep the wrapper unadmitted if it cannot compile without changing serializer/contracts or if identity/read-only/file-free gates fail; do not broaden formats or result ownership to make the test pass.
